name: card
title: Card
author: @fma-ds/ds
description:
A container for grouping related content, with header, title, description, action, content, and footer slots. Supports a compact size="sm" variant.

`CardContent bleed` drops the content's side padding, so a table, a list or an image spans the card's edges; `bleed="end"`, for content that closes the card, also drops the card's bottom padding, like a `CardFooter` does. `CardFooter sticky` stays at the bottom of the screen while a long card scrolls, on an opaque surface, and the card stops clipping its overflow so it can stick.
